environment.description: Application deployed behind AWS Application Load Balancer with the following listener configuration: (1) ALB target group health check on /health with 5s interval, (2) AWS WAF WebACL attached to ALB with rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' in COUNT mode and a custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5-minute window per source IP on URI path '/login' with action BLOCK (returns 429), (3) ALB request body size limit configured at default 1MB. The rate-based rule evaluates ALL requests matching the /login path regardless of HTTP method. Note: the WAF SQLi/XSS managed rules are in COUNT mode only (not blocking). The application's /login endpoint processes POST bodies with Content-Type application/json. Stack canaries enabled at OS level (SSP) but ASLR is also disabled on this host for compatibility with legacy sidecar.
